data_status: internal development validation only; no untouched independent holdout
exposure_policy: Exclude every Friday source row and every original observation group or coarse five-input signature linked to Friday or TASK02 grouped-test rows. Read exposed features only for exclusion signatures, never exposed labels/scores/errors.
signature: round(log1p(x)/0.10) for rate, volume, mean size, response std; exact exported integer direction ratio. Original groups must map to one signature or preparation fails.
sampling: uniform deterministic source-row hash sampling without label stratification after exclusions; all rows retain original IDs and source days
roles: design signatures excluded from comparison; rotate remaining signature groups through train, policy calibration, assessment, one distinct bucket per role
candidate_budget: A_frozen: unchanged grouped TASK02 configuration, contextual only
A_refit: TASK02 architecture fitted on each training fold, fair baseline
B_membership: benign-reference training anchors with original rules
C_rules: B memberships plus predeclared design-evidence rule refinement
D_optional: at most one six/seven-input candidate only if training-only feature audit justifies it
policy_objective: On calibration only, maximize observation-signature-group-weighted recall subject to estimated FPR cap; ties prefer lower FPR then higher threshold; always include threshold 100 (no alerts)
selection: Among A_refit/B/C/(optional D), maximize mean assessment Balanced-policy group-weighted balanced accuracy subject to mean FPR <= 0.075. Replace baseline only if balanced accuracy improves by >=0.02 and paired group-bootstrap 95% lower bound on improvement >0; otherwise preserve original TASK02 recommended model. Frozen A is contextual, not a leakage-clean refit.
uncertainty: 500 paired bootstrap resamples of signature groups, conditional on fitted folds; not selection-adjusted, not host/session uncertainty
holdout_claim: None. Assessment folds participate in candidate selection and are internal validation. Earlier full-data EDA, baseline fitting and prior summaries preclude an independent test claim.
search_limit: No post-assessment rule/membership/feature search. Retain all candidate outcomes including failures.
